notes.title: How to play Trump and Virus？
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here is a brief explanation of how to play Trump and Virus. It contains several stages and has many different endings waiting for you to explore!

[b]Virus Spread: [/b]When the virus first appeared, nobody cared about it and did not know whether carrying the virus or not. They went out as usual. The virus spread at will. In this stage, you need to drive the plane to spread the virus. Different endings are determined by the number of infected balloons and whether the plane hit the infected balloons. 

[b]Biochemical protection:[/b] The virus has spread too widely to ignore. Everyone had to protect themself.
In this stage, you need to drive a plane to avoid the viruses that wander around. In a limited time, bump virus or not led to different stage next. 

[b]Virus campaign: [/b]The biochemical protection cannot stop the virus by far. People need to take the initiative to attack. By order of the president, you start to fight and eliminate the virus finally.
In this stage, you need to drive plane to shoot the virus. In a limited time, different endings are determined by the number of virus you shoot down and whether the plane hit them.
[/h1]
[b]Heal the world: [/b]The virus is going out of control. Even the president is infected by the virus. You have to find a way to cure the president and heal the world.
In this stage, you need to drive a plane to shoot the Presidelloon which infected by virus with pills. In a limited time. Different endings are determined by the number of virus you shoot down and whether the plane hit them.

The game has three difficulty level: Easy, Normal and Hard. In any level, please pay attention that the following principles will directly affect your game ending.
1. Don't let your plane hit things except for viruses and virus balloons, or your will crash;
2. Whether bump the virus and the virus balloon leads to different ending;
3. Ammo is limited, use it wisely; 
4. Power storage will present AOE effect.
